name: MenuItemKind
meaning: MenuPage.kind (bits 0-1 of MenuPage.flags, MENU_F_KIND_MASK): Menu_AddPage writes 0, Menu_AddItems 1, and Menu_Update's switch on it gives each kind its input

name: MENU_KIND_PAGE
meaning: page/submenu: CROSS enters it (Menu_Update case 0; Menu_AddPage 0x54eb76)

name: MENU_KIND_ITEM
meaning: leaf item: LEFT/RIGHT/CROSS become MENU_MSG_LEFT/RIGHT/CONFIRM to its handler (Menu_Update case 1; Menu_AddItems 0x54ea70)
